Private wb As Object

Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Note = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Note = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Note = TypeName(v)
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Public Sub Setup()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Function S0() As String
    Dim ws As Object, c As Object, x As Variant, r As Variant, v As Variant, s As String, e As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add
    ws.Range("B2").Value = "abc": ws.Range("C3").Value = 7: ws.Range("E1").Value = 1.5: ws.Range("G1").Value = "abc"
    Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    On Error Resume Next
    x = CCur(1.5)
    c.Value = x
    e = Err.Number: Err.Clear
    s = Note(e, r)
    v = Empty: v = c.Value: s = s & "|" & Note(Err.Number, v): Err.Clear
    v = Empty: v = c.Formula: s = s & "|" & Note(Err.Number, v): Err.Clear
    S0 = s
End Function

Private wb As Object

Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Note = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Note = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Note = TypeName(v)
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Public Sub Setup()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

Public Function S0() As String
    Dim ws As Object, c As Range, x As Variant, r As Variant, v As Variant, s As String, e As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add
    ws.Range("B2").Value = "abc": ws.Range("C3").Value = 7: ws.Range("E1").Value = 1.5: ws.Range("G1").Value = "abc"
    Set c = ws.Range("B2")
    On Error Resume Next
    x = CCur(1.5)
    c.Value = x
    e = Err.Number: Err.Clear
    s = Note(e, r)
